_comment: Video bounds for the comparison series only -- kept separate from config/countries.json's global "video" block (45-80s) so this series' own target doesn't get clamped up to the other series' minimum, and so it doesn't affect them either. Passed as --video-config to generate_comparison_script.py / render_comparison_graphics.py and as --config to assemble_video.py for this series' runs only. Widened from an initial 30-40s: at that cap, natural-paced narration for 4 stat rows either got cut off mid-sentence or had to be read unnaturally fast to fit -- 35-60s gives the voice room to breathe at a normal pace, right at YouTube Shorts' 60s ceiling.
